disambiguation: Not a full document export suite; it specifically fixes Mermaid rendering in PDF and adds Word export.
extras: Requires manual installation of main.js and manifest.json.
intentEvidence: fixes the annoying issue where wide Mermaid diagrams (like sequence diagrams) get horizontally truncated/cut off when using Obsidian's native "Export to PDF" feature.
problem: Wide Mermaid diagrams are horizontally truncated or cut off when using Obsidian's native PDF export feature.
summary: A plugin that fixes horizontally truncated Mermaid diagrams during PDF export and adds Python-powered Word export.
